entities.summary: Nadka Vangelova Golcheva is a Bulgarian former basketball player who represented Bulgaria internationally from 1969 to 1983. She competed at two Olympic Games, winning a bronze medal at the 1976 Summer Olympics and a silver medal at the 1980 Summer Olympics.
